You are logged into OpenProject at http://localhost:8080 as admin (password: Admin1234!). You are a Software Developer leading the end-of-sprint retrospective for the 'ecommerce-platform' project.

Sprint 1 ('Sprint 1 - Launch MVP') is wrapping up. You need to close out completed work, document lessons learned, and prepare the backlog for the next sprint.

Your tasks:
1. The work package 'Optimize database queries for category listing' has been verified as complete. Change its status to 'Closed' (if not already) and add a comment: 'Verified in production. N+1 queries eliminated. Average category page load reduced from 2.3s to 0.4s. Closing as resolved.'
2. The work package 'Implement product search with Elasticsearch' is still in progress and will carry over. Add a comment: 'Carrying over to Sprint 2. Search indexing complete but faceted filtering needs additional 3 days of work. Estimated 70% complete.'
3. Log 4 hours of time on 'Implement product search with Elasticsearch' with comment 'Sprint 1 retrospective: code review and documentation of search API endpoints' and today's date.
4. Create a new version (sprint) named 'Sprint 2 - Performance & Search' in the ecommerce-platform project with status 'Open', start date 2025-08-01 and due date 2025-08-31.
5. Move 'Implement product search with Elasticsearch' to the new 'Sprint 2 - Performance & Search' version since it's carrying over.
6. Create a wiki page in the 'ecommerce-platform' project titled 'Sprint 1 Retrospective' with content that includes: what went well (database optimization completed ahead of schedule), what didn't go well (search feature underestimated), action items (improve estimation process, add buffer for complex features), team velocity data, and the carry-over items list.
